 Dated this the 16th day of December,2016  ORDER Antony Dominic, J.

When these delay petitions were taken up for consideration, learned counsel for the petitioners themselves produced before us copy of the order passed by the Supreme Court in SLP Nos.24291- 24293/2016 wherein leave has been granted by the Apex Court in appeals filed against the judgments, the review of which is sought in these petitions.

In view of the pendency of the Civil Appeals before the Apex Court, these review petitions cannot be entertained and for that reason, the delay petitions and consequently the review petitions are dismissed.

Sd/-
ANTONY DOMINIC JUDGE Sd/-
